settings.blocks: ground: gaps > 0.25 d within a dataset; TESS: 1-d chunks
settings.shuffle_groups: dataset x apparition (apparitions separated by gaps > 100 d)

event_geometry.columns: pab_lon_min, pab_lon_max, pab_lat_min, pab_lat_max, alpha_min, alpha_max (deg)
event_geometry.subset_definition: angular distance of the phase-angle-bisector direction (or its antipode) from the PAB directions of the reported mutual-event windows (2006 Feb 24-Apr 17, CBET 504; 2019 Jan 22-Mar 1, Franco et al. 2019) <= 5 deg (strict) or <= 10 deg (loose). Note: the 2005 Dec-2006 Jan run without events (CBET 369) lies 3-4 deg from the 2019 event direction, so the event zone is narrow and these subsets are approximate.

injection.events: two equal 4-h box dips per 117.0-h orbit, added to chunk-permuted residuals
two equal 4-h box dips per 117.0-h orbit, present in every included apparition (optimistic), added to night-permuted residuals
two equal 4-h box dips per 117.0-h orbit, present in every included apparition (optimistic), added to night-permuted residuals
two equal 4-h box dips per 117.0-h orbit, present in every included apparition (optimistic), added to night-permuted residuals

ground_stack.method: residuals of a fit with per-apparition Fourier coefficients (order 2, both periods; apparitions with >= 60 points) and offsets per dataset x apparition; night means weighted by pooled within-night scatter + night jitter; folded at each trial period into 0.05-phase bins (two bin offsets), z = weighted mean / its sigma, maximum over phase (positive = fainter) summed over apparitions; target windows 117 +- 1.5 h and half

ground_tail_test.definition: z = night-mean residual / its sigma (pooled within-night scatter + night jitter); positive = fainter; residuals of the per-apparition two-period fit (Sect. 4b)
ground_tail_test.expected_event_fraction: two ~4-h events per 117-h orbit -> ~7-9% of nights (each ~1 h long) inside an event, if the whole subset is in the event zone

per_apparition_amplitudes.note: peak-to-peak of order-2 Fourier fits of both periods with dataset offsets; not corrected for the noise bias (about +16% at 0.1 mag, Sect. ampresults)

dilution_estimates.note: equal albedos and phase behaviour; observed amplitudes 0.12 (18.21 h) and 0.09 mag (5.15 h) from Table 2; intrinsic peak-to-peak amplitude needed
